latestTerminalSummary:
Reviewed frozen `30cf377a579e95fef8315d4e9c8fbff95bf18109`, parent `8cdb8c12d7bf9a2c17eac8b7172eb28bea217ab3`, against clean SDK `c9c5979f04cea8c38213004d4f04df0dcfb40d05`. Handoff source/SDK hashes match; the integrated three-file delta is identical. Parent-only copy, plane and CMake changes are outside this frozen verdict.

**Both prior findings are closed by source inspection; their runtime witnesses remain unrun.**

- **R1 STEP-span overflow:** the finite-positive span check rejects `[-DBL_MAX, DBL_MAX]` before detach.
- **R2 Jacobian overflow:** the finite-positive Jacobian check rejects `2^1023 / 0.5` before detach. Directed derivative multiplication stages are also checked. See [line arithmetic guards](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-89ed4b23/native/smlib-adapter/src/plane_identity_uv.hpp:64).

**No new concrete defect found in the bounded reviewed class.** Inspection covered both parameter-conversion orientations, both line-position multiplication groupings, STEP and NURBS first derivatives, literal-zero higher derivatives, plane position groupings and additions, first partials, normal return, and inherited identity UV converters. The extrema argument is sufficient for finiteness within the admitted intervals and independent signed coordinate axes; it does not prove bitwise evaluator equivalence.

Ownership and seal inspection found no additional confirmed defect. Proofs and allocations precede detach; original trims move under unique ownership. Restoration requires the same destination, an unchanged topology/material/parameter/coefficient seal, unchanged retained trim signatures, canonical owner checks, and actual method2 admission. Exact dyadic predicates and endpoint oracles remain intact.

Qualification holds remain:

- `TurnToNURBS` calls `ReplaceSurface`, which resets face domains and recreates trims before edge conversion. Successful seal/restoration reachability remains unproven.
- Actual R1/R2 SDK negatives, method2 positive, separate six-record method8/v2 positive, Rust `plane_clip.rs:48`, and status8 cleanup remain **UNRUN/held**.
- The first producer of the observed endpoint discrepancy and its canonical-map equivalence remain unproven.
- No general affine, paired partition/layer, appearance, solver, or whole-product fidelity qualification follows.

Read-only review only; no edits, builds, tests, or heavy jobs performed.
